query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) as total_cards,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ds.cardId) as cards_with_snkrdunk,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) - COUNT(DISTINCT ds.cardId) as cards_without_snkrdunk
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN dataSources ds ON c.id = ds.cardId AND ds.source = 'snkrdunk';
